## Executive Summary

The .fr ccTLD is currently served by 3 authoritative nameservers.

3 of 3 authoritative nameservers support IPv6 connectivity, resulting in an IPv6 enablement rate of 100.0%.

The authoritative DNS infrastructure is distributed across 4 distinct Autonomous Systems, improving resilience against network and routing failures.

According to Cloudflare Radar, 8.75% of DNS queries were successfully validated using DNSSEC.

DNSSEC validation rates vary across major networks, ranging from 1.37% to 16.64%.
